subject: 輪機工程（包括推進裝置、輔機與輪機英文）

essays.text: 船用四行程柴油機氣缸蓋裝設多項重要構件，試列出五項重要構件名稱並說明其功能。（25 分）
試繪船舶之推進軸系簡圖，並標示其重要構件之名稱。（25 分）
船用柴油引擎氣缸之示功圖又稱為指示線圖，試繪該線圖，並說明其各熱力過程。（25 分）

請將下列輪機英文翻譯成中文：（25 分）Theoretically, the two-stroke cycle engine, with one working or power strokeevery revolution, develops twice the power of a four-stroke engine of the sameswept volume. The four-stroke engine rotating at medium speed, usuallybetween 250 and 750 rev/min, is used for auxiliaries such as generators andsometimes for main propulsion with a gearbox.
